name: Lang's Old Car Parts, Inc.
old_description: Lang's Old Car Parts is a family owned company with a true passion for the Model T Ford. We have the most complete catalog available on the market, including new and used Model T parts. We also carry a large selection of accessories, books and instructional movies. Ever since our founding over 35 years ago, we have worked hard to provide the best Model T parts with the great customer service and free technical support.
about:
Lang's Old Car Parts, Inc. operates from Baldwinville, Massachusetts. The family-owned business was founded more than 35 years ago, growing from a passion for the Model T Ford that began with selling used parts at swap meets. The company remains under family stewardship, though specific founders are not named in public materials.

The company maintains what it describes as the most complete catalog of Model T Ford parts on the market, offering both new and used components as well as new-old-stock (NOS) items. Beyond parts, the inventory includes accessories, books, and instructional movies. Free technical support is provided by a staff in which three-quarters reportedly own a Model T themselves. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Lang's serves Model T enthusiasts, hobbyists, and restorers — primarily individuals restoring or maintaining Ford Model T automobiles and Fordson tractors. The customer base spans antique automobile restoration and vintage automotive hobbyist sectors.

The business emphasizes its family-owned heritage and the personal passion of its staff as differentiators. It was started to fill a gap in the availability of correct, quality Model T parts and to offer the technical guidance that hobbyists often need.
